sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Isn't that bad for you?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: Yeah, but hell, what are you gonna do?

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Could I have some?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: No sweetie, you don't want to end up like me, all washed up and nowhere to go. I used to be quite a looker, still am, but I draw a different crowd now.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: I'll tell you, I've been smoking a lot more lately. Nothing to do in this town. It's lost a lot of its spirit.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: Talking to all these... Well, what's a polite word to call them...

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Lame-o's?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: ...Talking to these lame-os is such a drag, it's draining my life force. You know what I mean?

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Yeah, I do.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: You look so sad all on your own, it's a whole without a half, isn't it?

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: I guess.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: I went to one of those parties by the bridge, I thought it would bring back that feeling... won't be doing that again.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Veronica said it was "All out of whack".

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: That's one way of putting it.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: You know what I've been thinking?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: I think people are having a harder time coping these days. Everybody has some kind of distraction, something to obsess over.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Like you and your cigarettes?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: You got me there.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: That kid just showed me his phone and yelled, "Let's go!" and pumped his fist in the air. I haven't the slightest clue what he was going on about.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: Just two people sharing a moment, completely isolated from one another.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Huh.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: And I've been sittin' here. Smokin'.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: No one's really helped much since you left.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: That's not very fair, is it..?

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: I'm sorry.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: It's not your fault. A lot of people tend to give up when they feel like nothing they do about a situation will matter.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Can one person really make a difference?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: You've made a difference to me.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: We can't save everyone. But we can show up.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: I rely on you a lot, as well. We all need each other.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: I know.

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: Thank you...

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: For what?

sequence.speaker: Lady
sequence.text: Listening to me.
